# tcs-render-remotion

Renders a lesson storyboard.json (or every lesson in a runs/<id> folder) to MP4 with the plugin's own standalone Remotion kit — narration TTS, cue timing, stock b-roll, 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1, QA stills and frame grids — self-contained, needing only Node and ffmpeg.

Part of the **[Training Content Studio](../../README.md)** plugin. See its "which skill when" guide.

## What it's for
Turn any schema-valid `storyboard.json` into a finished MP4 with zero hand-written scene code. The shared kit
(`kit/`, Remotion 4) has one component per `enums.templates` entry; scripts here voice the narration, time every
`^` cue, fetch assets and render. Missing keys/assets never block: placeholders are used and listed.

## When to use it
- Use for "render the video with Remotion", "standalone render", "make the vertical version", or "QA stills of the lesson"; it is the default video renderer.
- **Not for:** rendering through the user's OpenMontage install (tcs-render-openmontage), decks/HTML/SCORM/job aids (tcs-render-lesson), or writing/fixing storyboards (tcs-storyboard).

## Install
```bash
# whole plugin (recommended: scripts use the shared schemas/, kit/, assets/)
git clone https://github.com/TamerElsherif/tamer-skills && claude --plugin-dir tamer-skills/training-content-studio
```
Prerequisites: Python 3.12 venv with `tools/requirements.txt` (plugin root); keys via env or `TCS_ENV_FILE` (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for narration/transcription, `PEXELS_API_KEY` optional); Node 18+ and ffmpeg for video renders.

## How to use
```
/tcs-render-remotion <request or file>
```
**Inputs**

- `<L>.storyboard.json` (schemas/storyboard.schema.json) — or a run dir `runs/<id>/` holding
  `lessons/<L>/<L>[.<lang>].storyboard.json`. Optional `<L>.quiz.json` beside it (quiz scenes without `q/options`).
- Keys (env or the file named in `TCS_ENV_FILE`): `OPENAI_API_KEY` (gpt-4o-mini-tts + whisper-1 word timing),
  `PEXELS_API_KEY` (b-roll; `PIXABAY_API_KEY` optional). None are required.
- Optional media dirs: `TCS_MUSIC_DIR` / `assets/music/<bed>.mp3`, `TCS_SFX_DIR` / `assets/sfx/<name>.wav`.
- Tools: Node ≥ 18, ffmpeg/ffprobe, plugin venv `.venv/bin/python`. First use runs `kit/setup.sh` (npm install).

**Outputs**

- Run dir mode: `runs/<id>/renders/<L>/<target>/<L>[.<lang>]_<16x9|9x16|1x1>.mp4` + `.json` report + `.grid.jpg`;
  prepared work in `…/<target>/work/`. `target`: `video` (16:9, or 1:1 if the storyboard says so) | `video-vertical` (9:16).
- If a renderer/tool is unavailable: `RENDER_PENDING.md` in that target folder (reason + exact commands); exit 0.
- Work dir (`prepare.py --out`): `timeline.json` (`{"tl": …}` Remotion props), `timeline.ts` (same, as a module),
  `public/` (audio, broll, images, music, sfx), `missing_assets.json`, `prepare_report.json`, `qa/broll_sheet.jpg`.

## Examples
**Example 1: Render a lesson**
Prompt: `render M1L1 to video, 16:9 and a 9:16 cut`
Result: TTS + cue timing + b-roll → MP4s at −16 LUFS, frame grids for QA; placeholders + missing_assets.json when keys are missing.
